content-derived digest substituted for Git blob
manifest blob substituted for a different same-path blob

exact_git_blob_identity_rule.scheduled_chat_transport: First use the normal exact same-path Git file read. If full rendering omits or abbreviates metadata, perform exactly one same-path identity-only/minimal-range Git read. If that rendered result still abbreviates sha but returns a connector response resource, immediately read only that same response resource's metadata lines containing the sha and bind the complete 40-hex value. This response-resource metadata read is part of the same bounded identity transport, not a semantic retry/wait/poll/backoff and does not authorize any unrelated repository/resource read.
